messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take losartan exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Losartan is usually taken once per day.
You may take losartan with or without food.
Call your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea, or if you are sweating more than usual.
You can easily become dehydrated while taking losartan.
Dehydrated can lead to very low blood pressure, a serious electrolyte imbalance, or kidney failure.
Your blood pressure will need to be checked often.
You may need frequent blood tests.
If you have high blood pressure, keep using Losartan even if you feel well.
High blood pressure often has no symptoms.
Store tightly closed at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light.
Triplet: ["high blood pressure", "has no symptoms", "often"]

The relation 'has no symptoms' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition typically does not present with noticeable symptoms.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not caused by': The subject medical condition is not associated with the cause specified by the object entity.
B. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the anatomical or physiological entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'is different from': The subject condition or effect is distinct or different from the object condition or effect.
D. 'caused by': The subject condition or symptom is caused by the object condition or factor.
E. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
